title: silver-pond-retail-integration-call-notes-2026-09-20
content:
Meeting: Silver Pond Retail - integration scoping call
Date: 2026-09-20
Attendees: Mark Reynolds (Silver Pond - CTO), Lina Torres (Head of Data), Rajiv Singh (Ops), Ava Chen (Redwood SE), Diego Morales (Redwood Solutions)

High-level objective:
- Silver Pond wants to replace legacy rule-based product recommendation engine with Redwood-powered LLM pipeline for in-app recommendations + email personalization. MVP = recommendations endpoint + A/B experiment to compare lift.

Notes / requirements called out by customer:
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 120ms for online recommendations (single-shot, short prompt).
- Throughput: 150 qps baseline with bursts to 400 qps during promotions.
- Data privacy: PII-scrubbed input; prefer Dedicated or Private deployment. Must support Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) and KMS integration.
- Region/residency: Primary infra in us-west1, DR in us-east1. No EU hosting required initially.
- Model quality: want GPT-like summarization/semantic ranking quality. Open to using open LLaMA-family variants or Redwood-verified models.
- Cost sensitivity: forecasted traffic implies material monthly spend; Silver Pond is interested in Dedicated reserved capacity pricing (monthly commit).
- Offline batch: need embeddings for offline catalog recompute nightly (~10M products), prefer vector DB output (FAISS/Annoy) or Redwood embeddings export.
- Feature flags / rollout: must be able to do canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full with automatic rollback on quality regression.

Technical gotchas / constraints I noted:
- Their product catalog includes long structured attributes; prompt engineering will need to handle truncation. Consider prefix/KV caching for session-level user context to stay within token budgets.
- Embedding throughput for 10M items nightly requires careful batching + GPU memory considerations; may need dedicated batch workers or offline GPU cluster.
- Their infra team uses only Terraform-managed infra; Private deployment needs validated Terraform modules or a clear onboarding checklist.
- They currently authenticate services via Okta SAML + SCIM; we need to confirm SCIM provisioning cadence and whether they want Redwood SCIM integration for service accounts.
- They asked about GDPR data handling (even though not EU), want controls for retention + delete-on-request API. Add as requirement for Private/Dedicated contract.

Suggested model/infra options to propose (notes for proposal draft):
- Hosted API quick PoC: use hosted Redwood API with strict prompt sanitization and redaction to validate quality (low friction). Measure latency/throughput.
- Dedicated reserved pool for production: 2-4 GPU nodes (A100/80GB eq) with autoscale policy for promo bursts; pin model variant (quantized) optimized for low-latency. Include BYOK and KMS.
- Private (VPC) as longer-term: if they require on-prem or strict network controls. Prepare Terraform module checklist and on-prem packaging notes.
- Embedding pipeline: offline worker cluster with batched embedding calls, sharded exports to S3, then bulk import to their vector DB. Include rate-limits and retry logic.

Open questions to follow up with Silver Pond:
- Exact qps profile: can they provide hourly/daily traffic for a typical week + peak promo window?
- SLA expectations for dedicated (uptime, error budget).
- Do they need PII-level redaction handled by Redwood or will they pre-scrub? Who owns compliance?
- SCIM: do they want Redwood to provision service accounts or will they manage manually?
- Nightly embedding window: preferred start time and maximum allowed runtime (SLAs for batch jobs).
- Any internal model preferences or regulatory constraints that would rule out open-weight models?

Immediate next steps / action items (owners & due dates):
- Draft proposal: capacity sizing + cost estimate + migration plan (Ava Chen) — due 2026-09-24.
- Collect traffic profile from Silver Pond (Mark) — ask via Slack + follow-up email (Ava) — due 2026-09-22.
- Security questionnaire preliminary: send standard Dedicated/Private security checklist (Diego) — due 2026-09-23.
- Terraform/onboarding checklist for Private: collate existing modules + notes (Priya) — due 2026-09-27.
- PoC plan: low-friction hosted API pilot with 10k sample users and daily batch embed job (Ethan) — draft 2026-09-26.

Notes-to-self (informal):
- When sizing dedicated pool, assume 1.2ms/token on quantized Llama-2-like model at 8k context for A100 equiv — translate to tokens/sec -> estimate costs. (Check infra team for up-to-date perf numbers)
- Emphasize rollout capabilities in proposal: canary + auto rollback tied to eval-sets is a differentiator.
- Prepare sample prompt templates for product recs vs email personalization; include token budget calc and fallback epsilon-greedy reranker to avoid hallucinations.

Slack / Jira refs pasted during call:
- Slack thread: #sales-silver-pond (link in email)
- Jira epic: JIRA-7894 (linked_artifacts)

Longer-term considerations (future convo):
- Model fine-tuning on Silver Pond's anonymized engagement data for personalization (estimate 6-8 weeks + data preparation).
- Real-time hybrid retrieval (RAG) to include catalog metadata + user event stream.
- Quality monitoring hooks: integrate Redwood Console evals with Silver Pond's product metrics (CTR, conversion lift).

End notes: felt positive vibe. CTO cares a lot about predictability and data controls; likely convert to Dedicated if we show predictable unit economics. Keep proposal conservative on capacity and strongly call out rollback + canary automation.

-- Ava
